sections.heading: C — Knowledge and road tests
sections.markdown:
## C — Knowledge and road tests

FACT_ID: sec02-F01 | anchor: A01
The knowledge examination assesses traffic signs, Pennsylvania driving laws and safe driving practices. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F02 | anchor: A01
The knowledge examination offers written and audio versions on request at Driver License Centers throughout Pennsylvania. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F03 | anchor: A01
Requested knowledge-test languages include Arabic, Burmese, Chinese Mandarin, English, French, Greek, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Nepali, Polish, Russian, Somali, Spanish, Ukrainian, Urdu and Vietnamese. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F04 | anchor: A01
After failing the knowledge examination, an applicant may retest on the next business day. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F05 | anchor: A01
A valid learner permit cannot be received until the knowledge examination has been passed. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F06 | anchor: A01
The knowledge examination has 18 questions with multiple-choice answers. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F07 | anchor: A01
An applicant passes the knowledge examination by answering 15 questions correctly. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F08 | anchor: A01
Drivers younger than 18 may schedule a skills test up to six months ahead. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F09 | anchor: A01
The non-commercial road examination requires an appointment. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F10 | anchor: A01
A road-test appointment can be scheduled through PennDOT's Driver and Vehicle Services website. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F11 | anchor: A01
Applicants without internet access may schedule the road test by calling 1-800-423-5542. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F12 | anchor: A01
PennDOT-certified third-party businesses may administer the same skills examination for a market-based fee. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F13 | anchor: A01
A road-test applicant must show a valid learner permit to the examiner. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F14 | anchor: A01
An applicant younger than 18 must present signed parent or guardian certification on DL-180C of 65 hours of driving practice. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F15 | anchor: A01
The road-test vehicle must have a valid registration card available for the examiner. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F16 | anchor: A01
The applicant must provide proof of current insurance for the road-test vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F17 | anchor: A01
The accompanying person's valid license must be presented, and that person must be at least 21 or a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse aged at least 18. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F18 | anchor: A01
The required road-test documents must be originals; copies do not qualify the applicant to be tested. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F19 | anchor: A01
Before the road test, the examiner checks current insurance, valid registration and a valid state inspection sticker, plus an emissions sticker when required. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F20 | anchor: A01
The examiner checks lights, horn, brakes, wipers, turn signals, mirrors, doors, seats and tires for safe operation before the road test. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F21 | anchor: A01
An unsafe vehicle part or failure to meet state inspection standards prevents the road test from proceeding. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F22 | anchor: A01
When the test vehicle has seat belts, they must be clean and usable, and both the applicant and examiner must wear them during the test. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

Misconceptions: passing the knowledge examination does not complete the road examination; a vehicle with automatic parking still requires manual control during testing.
Mnemonics: documents, vehicle, controls and safe maneuvers form the road-test preparation sequence.
Glossary: knowledge test checks understanding of driving rules; road test checks safe vehicle operation; certification documents completed driving practice.
Dynamic facts: no officeholder, local answer or time-varying value is asserted; handbook edition currency is tracked as source debt in the authority part.

items.why: This is a distinct learnable group of handbook rules requiring its own recall and application practice.
